ns2:section.sectionText: The purpose of this class is several fold: Create a capstone leadership course for our senior Business Honors students; Provide insights that will carry them into the “real world”; Establish an opportunity for the Business Honors class to strengthen ties amongst their group via a unifying academic experience in their final year; Create venues for our alumni base to meet with the class and share their leadership experiences.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Gies College of Business. Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Business Honors Program students.
